mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE status = 1) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food WHERE status = 1) AS food_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY')) AS pending_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE()) AS today_order_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED')), 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND status NOT IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED')), 0) AS today_revenue

SELECT i.food_id, i.food_name_snapshot AS food_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_item i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY i.food_id, i.food_name_snapshot ORDER BY quantity DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10
